desc: Derive the gap operation: `(g_i, g_{i+1}, g_{i+2})` becomes `(g_{i+2}, g_{i+1}, g_i)`.
Establish that reachable gap configurations are arbitrary independent permutations of odd-indexed and even-indexed gaps.
Derive the objective `N*X_1 + Σ_{j=1}^{N-1}(N-j)g_j` and the ascending-order rearrangement optimum within each parity.
Implement the parity-separated ascending gap sorting algorithm and pass both samples.
Confirm `O(N log N)` time, `O(N)` memory, and Python integer safety.
